articles.summary: In July 2021, New Jersey enacted a new law (P.L 2021, c.183) requiring all public community water systems to inventory and replace all known lead or galvanized steel service lines by 2031. Middlesex Water is pleased to join this statewide initiative focused on reducing lead in drinking water and improving public health. How Does Lead ... Read more
